units.source_text: 源氏公子回到二条院私邸，在自己房中休息。

en.t: Prince Genji returned to his private residence at Nijo-in and rested in his own room.

units.source_text: 愁恨满腹，无法排遣，打算静养一会，再赴左大臣邸。

en.t: Filled with sorrow and resentment that he could not dispel, he planned to rest quietly for a while before going again to the Minister of the Left's residence.

units.source_text: 庭中草木畅茂，青青满目，其中抚子花正在盛开。

en.t: The plants and trees in the garden were growing luxuriantly, filling the eye with fresh green, and among them the pinks were in full bloom.

units.source_text: 公子便摘了一枝，写一封信，将花枝附在信上，送给王命妇。

en.t: The prince then picked one branch, wrote a letter, attached the flowering branch to it, and sent it to O no Myobu.

units.source_text: 信中千言万语，并附诗句：

en.t: The letter contained countless words of feeling, and he also added these lines of verse:
